description: AGU's journal class agujournal2025.cls ([11/12/2024] in its \ProvidesClass), the one class for all AGU journals. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror (MiKTeX's aguplus is the old AGU++ bundle): from github.com/AGU-Publications/agujournal2025-latex-template at commit 3550522 (2026-03-27), the repository that agu.org/publications/authors/journals links as AGU's GitHub template. agu.org's own zip of the older agujournal2019.cls (an .ashx under agu.org/publications/authors/-/media) refuses scripted downloads (HTTP 403), so the 2019 class is not used; the repository has no licence file (kept private). draft is the option the template sets (agujournaltemplate.tex l.1-4): without published the class takes its 'old code' branch (agujournal2025.cls l.812 on), the agujournal2019 manuscript layout: one column, letter paper, a self-contained article-like class (no \LoadClass), apacite citations with \let\cite\shortcite (l.1970-1972), lineno, and a 'manuscript submitted to <journal>' running head. published (the Wiley typeset look, which needs unicode-math, STIX Two Math, TeX Gyre Adventor, draftwatermark and the repository's tweaklist-git-moderncv-fixed.sty) is not used. \journalname fills the running head, which otherwise reads 'Please set Journal Name by using \journalname' (l.1371-1372); the template calls it after \begin{document}, but it is a plain \def, so the preamble works. In the draft layout \title typesets its title at once (agujournal2025.cls l.1376) and \maketitle does nothing (l.822), so a \title in the preamble stopped at 'Missing \begin{document}'. The last line keeps a preamble \title until \maketitle and runs the class's own \title there, and leaves \title as the class has it after \begin{document} (the \document=\@notprerr test iopart's line uses); \maketitle then also runs the class's own. Probe run 41977413848: the control case stops at 'Missing \begin{document}', the held cases (title in the preamble, title in the body) do not. agujournal2025.cls defines no \abstractname, which abstract.sty and its run-in title use (round b28: 77 cells, 2,381 branches, 'Undefined control sequence' at \abstractname); the last line gives the kernel default, as for ieeeconf-ras. The second line sets US letter paper explicitly, so the sentinels are measured on a page of known size (probes B3C-agu-dcc243-new and B3C-agu-d18afd-new: paper 614.295pt by 794.97pt, sentinel:outside 36 to 2, the same pages and boxes). agu's \labelitemi raises its bullet with \raise, which fails in internal vertical mode ('You can't use \raise in internal vertical mode', round b28: 506 branches); the redefinition starts a paragraph first (probes B3B-agu-bullet-new, B3B-agu-bullet2-new).
